svg.title: System pipeline booting
svg.desc: The intraday equity trading platform boots service by service: broker session, news candidates, market feed, Neon Postgres and Cloudflare R2, the Socket.IO relay on Render, then the Next.js desk and Expo mobile app. Packets then stream end to end and telemetry feeds back into the engine.

g.text: Ubuntu 24.04 VPS · systemd · Render · Vercel Edge · Neon Serverless · Cloudflare R2 · Expo EAS · Broker API
mounting market feed & warm-up candle aggregators
neon postgres connected · cloudflare r2 session bucket primed
socket.io relay handshake verified (render) · expo push ready
next.js brutalist desk hydrated · expo mobile client connected
all systems nominal · awaiting 09:21 volume promotion pass
